architecture: v3 (re-root 2026-10-31: a municipal bus company's collision warnings by depot, the 2027 driver-attention programme read on the warnings that were genuine)
slot_note: re-root of task191 in the same objective (Anomaly Detection & Diagnostics), batch 1; architecture 2 moved to lineage, spent at stage 2
niche: a municipal bus fleet's forward-collision and pedestrian warnings, read for the depots whose drivers let genuine warnings pass
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file and the programme's terms correctly takes each depot's share of collision warnings with no brake application within two seconds against the fleet's, the fleet safety dashboard's own measure, and perhaps sets aside the places that raise the most warnings as nuisance places; the first files the two depots whose routes pass the fixed structures that fire a warning on almost every pass at speed, and the second also throws away the busy pedestrian streets where the warnings are real, so neither files the depot whose drivers let genuine pedestrian warnings pass there.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each depot's rate of not braking on genuine collision warnings, the human-factors measure of warning compliance, which alarm research reads on valid alarms only because operators rightly learn to let a warning that is false at a known place go; with another field's nouns (fraud alerts, smoke alarms) there is no bus passing a place at speed, no fixed structure that fires on nearly every pass and no brake response, and the task stops reading the same.
layer1: warnings stamped in UTC beside a running-time database in local time, across the 25 October 2026 clock change
warnings located by GPS point while running times are kept by stop-to-stop link, matched through the link register
the December 2025 network change renumbering links and moving routes between depots
drivers found through the ticket machine's log-on records, which leave gaps and double log-ons
buses lent between depots for days at a time
telematics messages resent after lost connections, the same warning twice
warning types coded differently by two firmware versions
stakeholder_role: the bus company's head of driving safety, who proposes the 2027 driver-attention programme's depots to the management committee

spine.entity: one forward-collision or pedestrian warning raised on a bus

world.geography: Spain (a fictional Andalusian city and its municipal bus network)
invented_names: Empresa Municipal de Autobuses de Lorvega

driver: Each unit's rate of failing to act on a warning is read only on the warnings whose trigger was real, because the warning system fires on nearly every pass at a few fixed places where nothing is ever in the way and operators rightly let those go, while the places where real hazards cluster fire on a small share of passes; the two kinds of place are told apart only by the share of passes on which the system fires, which no count of warnings carries, so the units whose routes cross the fixed places look worst and the unit that lets real hazards pass looks ordinary.
driver_concrete: Each depot's share of genuine forward-collision and pedestrian warnings with no brake application within two seconds, where the warnings raised on most passes at speed by a few fixed structures on the new network (a low rail bridge, the busway's bollards, a tight bend's crash barrier) are not genuine and are set aside, told apart from the busy pedestrian streets where warnings are real but rare only by warnings per bus passage at speed from the running-time database.
stump: The fleet dashboard's measure, the no-brake share of every collision warning by depot against the fleet's, files the two depots whose routes run under the rail bridge and along the busway, and setting aside the places with the most warnings also drops the pedestrian streets where the warnings are genuine and files no depot; the depot whose drivers let genuine pedestrian warnings pass in those streets is flagged only once the fixed false-trigger places are removed by their share of passes at speed and the genuine hotspots are kept.

lineage.niche: judging the worst of many monitored series when the worst was chosen for being worst
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is whether the largest shortfall among many candidate series is larger than the largest a quiet set of the same size and length produces, because the candidate was chosen for standing out, so judging it against the spread of one series calls a routine extreme a real degradation.
lineage.driver_concrete: Seven interconnects are watched every evening for a quarter and the worst of them is put forward, so the figure to beat is the distribution of the worst of seven over a quarter of evenings, which the uncongested paths' own record puts well above the one-series bound the worst interconnect clears.
lineage.stump: A competent solver builds each interconnect's evening shortfall against its own daytime baseline, tests the worst one against its own variation, finds it clears comfortably and funds the augment, where the same shortfall is inside what the worst of seven quiet paths produces in a quarter.
lineage.answer: Fund no interconnect augment this cycle.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at the batch 1 re-root: shipped 2026-10-17 on the interconnect worst-window call (fund nothing), its decisive step measured as landed in-house before any portal result; the multiple-testing cell, the filed comparison criterion and the statistic-of-a-statistic reference retired with it

lineage.niche: a functional genomics facility's genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen of one cancer cell line, read for the line's own dependencies before arrayed validation
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's own effect on an outcome measured through several probes, where every probe in a region also carries a damage term that grows with how many copies of the region the system holds, so units sitting in a multiplied region rank as the most affected and units in a lost region look spared; only the effect net of the region's damage, read off the reference units known to have no effect, ranks the units for the few places available.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each gene's knockout effect in OSR-7 is read through four guides, and a guide that cuts in an amplified region also kills cells through the extra DNA breaks, so the genes of the line's amplicons look like strong dependencies and genes in its single-copy segments look spared; only the guide-level depletion net of the copy-number cutting effect, estimated on the non-essential reference genes across the line's copy-number states, gives the dependencies the institute validates.
lineage.stump: A competent solver normalises the screen's guide counts, scales each gene's median depletion so that the non-essential reference genes sit at 0 and the common essentials at -1, sets the common essentials aside and fills the arrayed round's places with the most depleted genes past -0.5, most of them passenger genes of the line's amplicons, where the effect net of the copy-number cutting effect keeps the amplicons' own driver dependencies, drops their passengers and brings in dependencies from the single-copy segments.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-31 at stage 2 with no data cut: the previous fork's drafting of the knockout-screen world was interrupted by a safety classifier, so the slot re-rooted to a cell far from genome editing, laboratory biology and anything dual-use; the design was never built or shipped
